name: Nintendo 3DS — legal hold
license: GPL-2.0 (upstream tainted — do not build from post-2024 forks)
blocked_reason: Citra was taken down March 2024 under the Nintendo/Yuzu settlement. 3DS emulation requires bootrom dumps + title-key decryption (DMCA 1201 anti-circumvention exposure). PabloMK7-era forks carry the same taint. DO NOT build or distribute a 3DS core until cleared by IP counsel. Architecture slot reserved for that day.
